title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 9.3 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 9.3 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to access protected CI/CD variables and resources due to a race condition in pipeline job authorization. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
